title: Adversarial Agents Registry
description: Registry of independent pull-request review agents, their versioning, and configuration.

agents.description: List of configured adversarial review agents.

version.description: Semantic version of the agent implementation.

enabled.description: Whether this agent is active in CI.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this agent checks.
examples: Detects weak unit tests, missing edge cases, tautologies, and unsafe mocking patterns.

promptFile.description: Relative path to the human-editable prompt file from repository root.

promptVersion.description: Current semantic version of the prompt. Updated when the prompt file changes.

toolsConfigFile.description: Relative path to the agent-specific bounded-tools contract.

contextConfigFile.description: Relative path to the agent-specific bounded context profile.

contextConfigVersion.description: Semantic version of the agent context profile.

modelDeployment.description: Azure or cloud model deployment identifier.

modelVersion.description: Semantic version or release date of the model, for compatibility tracking.

toolsVersion.description: Semantic version of agent tools and integrations.

executionConfig.description: Per-agent execution overrides (timeouts, retries, token limits).

temperatureFraction.description: LLM temperature for reproducibility tuning. 0 = deterministic, 1 = default, > 1 = exploratory.

targetScopes.description: What parts of the repository this agent reviews (e.g., test files, production code).

excludePatterns.description: File glob patterns to exclude from review.

contactEmail.description: Owner contact for questions, false positives, or tuning requests.

verdictRules.description: Agent-specific rules for how findings translate to verdict.

blockingThreshold.description: Number of HIGH-confidence findings that trigger a BLOCKING verdict.

allowHighConfidenceOnly.description: If true, only HIGH-confidence findings can cause a FAIL. Security agents may use independently defined severity and control-bypass thresholds instead.

examples.name: unit-test-reviewer
examples.description: Detects weak unit tests, missing edge cases, tautologies, and unsafe mocking patterns.

subscriptionId.description: Default Azure subscription where agents are deployed.

requirementsMet.description: Track which US-01 contract requirements are met by this registry.

versionedJsonSchema.description: Requirement 1: Strict versioned JSON schema for findings.

dedicatedPromptFiles.description: Requirement 2: Each agent has a dedicated human-editable prompt file with version and hash.

independentVersioning.description: Requirement 3: Prompt, policy, schema, model, and tool versions are independent.

validationRequired.description: Requirement 4: Invalid, incomplete, or unactionable results fail validation.

agentRegistration.description: Requirement 5: Contract supports registering additional agents without coupling.
